notes.title: Like a creepy version of hide and seek, It Has My Face is out in Early Access
notes.notes:
Creepy stuff. It Has My Face makes you seek out your clone amongst the crowd, like some sort of hide and seek but with a real sinister vibe.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/09/like-a-creepy-version-of-hide-and-seek-it-has-my-face-is-out-in-early-access/

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS VERSION OUT NOW
notes.notes: [p]The Early Access version of IT HAS MY FACE is officially out.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]When compared to the demo, this Early Access version of IT HAS MY FACE contains a megaton worth of new content. Highlights include:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]A bunch of [b]new story chapters[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]The endless, face-meltingly difficult [b]“Invasion” mode[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="justify"] [b]1v1 MULTIPLAYER[/b], a glimpse of the friend-slaughtering possibilities to come[/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"]All the foundations of our full game are here. However, we have much more planned, and we’d like your help in building it. We don’t just want your faces, we also want your feedback. We would particularly love your thoughts on balancing, multiplayer features, and any additional content you think would help make IT HAS MY FACE the best game it can be.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Please do not hesitate to give us your opinions on Steam, as well as through [url="https://discord.gg/PJ6HSeeR"]Discord[/url] and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/ItHasMyFaceoffi/"]Reddit[/url]. We’ll be communicating with you often as we proceed through Early Access.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]For any [url="https://store.steampowered.com/agecheck/app/381210/"]Dead by Daylight[/url] players who are curious about the IT HAS MY FACE cross-promotion rewards, previewed below, please note that:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]You must create a [url="https://account.bhvr.com/"]BHVR Account[/url] to claim the rewards[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]The rewards won’t be available in Dead by Daylight until after players have completed the [b]9.2.0 update[/b], which will be available at approximately [b]12:00PM Eastern time on September 23[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We can’t wait to stab our clones with you. Thank you for your support on this journey.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484645/670cd78c54a07b27488449ba93ef1b3ffc3c303e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Bug Fix 1.0.11
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
We're pushing a small bug fix live addressing specifically Steam Deck users
Right now, no Steam Deck user can play the demo so this will fix that
 
Changelog:
[list]
[*] Versioning system changed from "Demo 0.9.69" to "Demo 1.0.11"
[*] Fixed stuck-on black screen during logos for Linux users
[*] Added localization folks to credits
[*] Added newsletter social button back
[*] Removed the wait for final data analytics before quit (faster quit)
[/list]

- wolderado
